title: Parametric magnetic saw guide
description: A magnetic guide for dovetail and square cuts. Customize the slope, magnet pockets, and dimensions, then inspect or download your model.
notes: The default guide uses a 1:5 dovetail slope and five pockets on each side, sized for 7.9375 mm × 1.984375 mm disc magnets. The model checks that pockets fit with enough surrounding material. Sections and wireframes only change the view; downloads always contain the complete solid.

attribution.text: Inspired by WordsFail’s 6:1 Small Dovetail Guide (reference license: CC-BY-NC-SA, as recorded in the original CAD source). This parametric implementation includes no reference mesh or artwork.
